# chalk_cloud_container_registry (Resource)

Registers a reference to a cloud container registry (Google Artifact Registry, AWS ECR, or Azure ACR) plus the cloud credential used to reach it.

The registry kind is inferred from which `config` block you set (`gar`, `ecr`, or `acr`); exactly one must be provided. Every attribute is replace-only (there is no update RPC). **Create-time access check:** creating this resource performs a live access check against the registry using the referenced `cloud_credential_id`; apply fails unless that credential can already reach the registry, so the credential must exist first.

**Required permissions:** `project.create` *(team-scoped)*

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A reference to a cloud container registry plus the credential used to reach it.
# The registry kind is inferred from which config block you set (gar/ecr/acr);
# exactly one must be provided, and its cloud provider must match the credential.
#
# Creating this performs a live access check against the registry using the
# credential, so the credential must exist first.

# Google Artifact Registry
resource "chalk_cloud_container_registry" "gar" {
  name                = "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/my-project/my-repo"
  cloud_credential_id = chalk_gcp_cloud_credentials.example.id
  config = {
    gar = {
      repository_name = "chalk-images"
    }
  }
}

# AWS Elastic Container Registry
resource "chalk_cloud_container_registry" "ecr" {
  name                = "123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/my-repo"
  cloud_credential_id = chalk_aws_cloud_credentials.example.id
  config = {
    ecr = {
      repository_name = "chalk-images"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_credential_id` (String) ID of the cloud credential (e.g. a `chalk_aws_cloud_credentials`/`chalk_gcp_cloud_credentials`/`chalk_azure_cloud_credentials` resource) used to access the registry. Its cloud provider must match the registry kind. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `config` (Attributes) Registry configuration. Set exactly one of `gar`, `ecr`, or `acr`; the one you set determines the registry `kind`. Changing this forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String) Fully-qualified registry path. For `gar`: `<location>-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/<repository>`; for `ecr`: `<account-id>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/<repository>`; for `acr`: `<registry>.azurecr.io`. Must match the kind implied by the `config` block. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `designator` (String) Optional server-side designator for the registry. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the registry was last applied, if any.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the registry was created.
- `id` (String) Cloud container registry identifier.
- `kind` (String) Container registry kind. One of `gar`, `ecr`, or `acr`. Derived from the `config` block you set.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the registry is managed by Chalk. Always false for this resource.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns the registry.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp at which the registry was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `acr` (Attributes) Azure Container Registry configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--acr))
- `ecr` (Attributes) AWS Elastic Container Registry configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--ecr))
- `gar` (Attributes) Google Artifact Registry configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--gar))

<a id="nestedatt--config--acr"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.acr`

Optional:

- `repository_name` (String) Name of the ACR repository to push customer-built images to.


<a id="nestedatt--config--ecr"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.ecr`

Required:

- `repository_name` (String) Name of the ECR repository to push customer-built images to.

Optional:

- `registry_id` (String) AWS account ID that owns the ECR registry. Optional; defaults to the account in `name`.


<a id="nestedatt--config--gar"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.gar`

Required:

- `repository_name` (String) Name of the Artifact Registry repository to push customer-built images to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cloud container registries are imported by their id.
terraform import chalk_cloud_container_registry.gar registry-id-abc123
```
